text:
emily: quick callout — noticed Node SDK drops `priority` on generate requests, REST accepts it. Causing scheduling to fall back to default low priority.

rashid: repro steps? sample app or customer report?

emily: internal sample: `await client.inference.generate({ model: 'gpt-base', input: 'hi', priority: 'high' })` -> server shows priority missing. curl with same body works.

olga: do you have outgoing payload dump?

emily: proxied body from SDK: `{"model":"gpt-base","input":"hi"}`

emily: curl body that works: `{"model":"gpt-base","input":"hi","priority":"high"}`

rashid: that suggests serializer ignores unknown enum or optional string fields. Might be generated client with an enum type that omits non-whitelisted values. Are you using a new priority value?

emily: priority is documented and present in OpenAPI. SDK version 1.0.0.

olga: other thing — REST client treats priority as hint and will not retry on 429 for high priority; our SDK retry layer always retries uniformly which can downgrade semantics and cause duplicate billing.

emily: exact error we saw on customer staging: request queued longer than expected because priority missing. Customer hit SLOs.

rashid: action items:
- olga: add parity unit test that sends priority via SDK and asserts server received it
- sdk-team: check enum codegen and ensure priority included; regenerate SDK if mapping wrong
- infra: ensure retry policy respects request-level hints (no retry for high-priority idempotent=false)

support-bot: Created issue redwood/sdk-node#678: "node SDK omits request.priority and applies uniform retry policy; causes scheduling and billing diffs" - https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/issues/678 :robot_face:

emily: temporary workaround for staging: call REST directly for high-priority requests using fetch. I'll add a comment in sample-apps/priority-demo.

olga: also scan other request-level hints (routing, tags) — could be broader codegen omission. I'll run a `diff` against openapi properties.

rashid: marking P1 for customer-impacting parity. Will schedule hotfix for 1.0.1.

emily: thanks — will ping when sample-app PR is up.
